purpose: Machine-readable map from existing solver research identity spellings to the canonical identity layers established by the hint-evidence consolidation plan. This is a migration/reader map, not permission to copy legacy names into new outputs.

canonicalLayers.meaning: Run-wide Pathfinder solver request semantics after canonical default normalization; excludes level/history-derived forcing, backend scheduling/reproducibility, solver revision, source run and population.

Per-level/per-attempt effective input identity: level revision + immutable solver version + canonical solver request identity + solver stage/action/config + gate/forcing + relevant resource envelope + seed dimensions.

Protocol comparability semantics across observations: configuration identity plus execution mode, history policy, reproducibility contract, scheduler and declared limits. Does not include solver revision or source-run identity.
Bounded identity glue for one acquisition run: run/attempt, immutable solver ref, configuration/protocol identity, producer/workflow/entrypoint, population/corpus, arm and source-run lineage.
Immutable 40-hex execution revision of the solver code actually used.
canonicalLayers.currentOwner: experiment.resolvedSha / experiment.arms.<arm>.resolvedSha at the experiment contract boundary

canonicalLayers.meaning: Population/selection identity and corpus binding; intentionally separate from solver request and execution protocol.

spellings.observedMeaning: Producer-local literal/effective SolveOpts-adjacent execution projection recorded by sweep reports.
spellings.migration: transitional producer output. Preserve historical readers. New producers should emit the canonical solver-request projection/identity rather than inventing another effectiveConfig shape.

spellings.observedMeaning: SHA-256 over producer-local effectiveConfig using canonical/stable serialization. Useful for shard/treatment agreement, but not a complete canonical solver-request identity.
spellings.migration: read historically; migrate maintained writers/consumers to the canonical solver-request identity after runtime bridge/parity is validated.

spellings.observedMeaning: Experiment configuration/treatment identity declared by the owning experiment contract.
spellings.migration: retain as a distinct specialist identity. It is one input to execution-protocol identity and must not be renamed to solver-request identity unless a specific producer proves semantic equivalence.

spellings.observedMeaning: Artifact-local projection of experiment configuration identity.
spellings.migration: retain only where the owning artifact explicitly means experiment configuration; historical reader spelling otherwise.

now generated by hashExecutionProtocol(). Before 2026-09-23 it incorrectly duplicated configurationHash; historical documents from that generation must be treated as configuration-only protocol evidence, not proof of full protocol equality.

spellings.observedMeaning: Lineage reference to a source experiment/protocol used by a reconciliation/recombination run.
spellings.migration: do not reinterpret as the current run's protocolHash. Preserve as lineage metadata and normalize through source-run binding/reconciliation readers.

spellings.observedMeaning: Immutable solver execution revision for a single-SHA experiment.
spellings.migration: canonical source when no per-arm SHA exists.

spellings.observedMeaning: Immutable solver execution revision for one experiment arm.

spellings.migration: acceptable role-qualified projection when sourced from resolvedSha; do not populate from mutable branch/ref names.

spellings.observedMeaning: Mixed-era result spellings for execution revision. Publisher already checks these when binding declared resolvedSha.
spellings.migration: historical/current specialist readers only; normalize at ingress and prefer resolvedSha/solverRef in new identity bindings.

spellings.observedMeaning: GitHub workflow checkout SHA (GITHUB_SHA), which may differ from the solver code revision when a workflow performs a custom checkout.
spellings.migration: never substitute for immutable solverRef unless equality is explicitly proved. Keep as workflow/source-run transport provenance.
normalize into sourceRunBinding.runId; do not include in semantic provenance-event identity.

spellings.observedMeaning: Attempt number of the physical workflow acquisition run.
Constituent acquisition-run lineage for recombined/reconciled evidence.
spellings.migration: preserve as sourceRunBinding.sourceRuns; never collapse constituent lineage to only the recombination run id.
remain separate from solver request/protocol identity; source-run binding references them.

knownHistoricalCaveats.affectedGeneration: hint-discovery-process schema v1 documents emitted before the 2026-09-23 hashExecutionProtocol fix
knownHistoricalCaveats.effect: protocolHash cannot prove execution-protocol equality because it was copied from configurationHash
knownHistoricalCaveats.handling: treat as configuration-only historical evidence unless the owning experiment contract is available and protocolHash can be recomputed exactly

knownHistoricalCaveats.effect: GITHUB_SHA/manifest.sha may identify the workflow checkout rather than a custom solver checkout
knownHistoricalCaveats.handling: bind immutable solver identity through experiment.resolvedSha or arm.resolvedSha and verify against primary result execution revision
